criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-cli` and `cargo test -p athena-core`: the drain test with a fake source check reporting a contradiction shows exactly one fix request queued through StewardRequest citing the statement and source, none on a second run while it is open, and a different contradiction in the same file is still queued.
criteria.evidence: All 8 tests in the new drain test filter passed. The main one, source_fix_queues_one_request_per_contradiction_and_none_while_open, calls the production RealSteps::check_page with a fake SourceJudge. After run 1 there is exactly one request: its first line is 'Source fix: studies/demo/claims.json contradicted c1', it contains the statement and the defanged evidence, it has Acceptance and Files sections, and it touches only studies/demo/claims.json. After run 2, with different case, spacing and evidence, there is still one. After run 3, a c2 contradiction in the same file is queued and there are two. Other tests cover a landed job not being re-queued in the same run, a later run re-queueing after a failure, the carry across a rebuild, and a stale carry being dropped. The request is built by steward::source_fix_request, which calls StewardRequest::new. 16 core pin and steward unit tests passed. The full athena-cli and athena-core suites passed in Athena's recorded `cargo test --locked`.

findings.summary: c45 is still not checked. Its new sources do not support its main fact (the row goes back to Queued), so the source check may keep reporting it.
findings.evidence: c45's text says "the backlog row goes back to Queued". The new sources are bin/fm-teardown.sh:30 ("The close - and only the close - is replaced by `tasks-axi reopen` with the") and bin/fm-backlog-transition-lib.sh:54 ("records the deliverable and reopens the row instead of closing it, and never"), copied from c23 and c24. Neither line mentions Queued. The CHANGELOG admits this and says the real source check may report c45. The retry's stated aim was to make the c45 citation checked. Now the deterministic quote validator will pass c45 on a mounted tree while its distinctive fact has no source, which hides the gap instead of closing it. A better route: on a host with pinned-source/ (ATHENA_PIN_URL/ATHENA_PIN_SHA set), read the reopen path and cite the line that sets the row to Queued. If no such line exists, narrow c45's text to what the cited lines say. Then run the source check.

findings.summary: A finding that matches no entry falls back to a hash of the checker's wording, so a reworded statement can be queued again in a later run.
findings.evidence: finding_anchor (pin.rs) returns 'h'+FNV hash of the normalised statement when no study entry, or more than three, contains or covers the statement. Different wording of the same contradiction then gives a different marker. The CHANGELOG documents this limit, and the once-per-run set bounds it within a run.

summary: The drain part of the change works and is well tested. When the source check reports a statement, one "Source fix: studies/<study>/<file> <kind> <anchor>" request is queued through StewardRequest. The anchor is the study entry that holds the statement, so the same contradiction is skipped however the checker words it, and a different contradiction in the same file is queued. A marker is queued at most once per drain run, including across a rebuild. All 8 new drain tests and 16 core tests pass. The study_text doc comment is back directly above `pub fn study_text`. The model and intro text were checked, not rewritten. CI recorded fmt, clippy and the full test suite as passing. The job still fails on the c45 citation, which the retry was meant to fix. The pinned source is not in this copy: the conventions test printed "conventions only". So c45 was re-cited to two lines that other claims (c23, c24) already cite. Those lines say the item is reopened. They do not say the backlog row goes back to Queued. The claim's main fact is still unsupported. The CHANGELOG says this honestly, and also says the real source check may keep reporting c45. Criterion 3 ("the drain source check passes on the corrected study") is therefore not shown. The producer's own note predicts it may fail. To finish, someone needs to run this on a host with the pinned source (or ATHENA_PIN_URL/ATHENA_PIN_SHA set and pinned-source/ mounted), find the line where the reopen sets the row to Queued, cite it, and then run the source check.
